label: Declared gross patrimoine (HATVP déclaration de patrimoine)
amount: ≈ €4,887,962 gross (sum of declared assets before debt); press commonly rounded to ≈ €4.2M
detail: Itemized declared assets from the 2022 HATVP candidate declaration (published 8 March 2022): real estate €2,886,440; 90% stake in Rubempré €1,530,000; assurance-vie €444,335; bank accounts €13,587. Press reporting widely cited an approximate ≈€4.2M figure, ranking him among the wealthier 2022 candidates. Declared, not estimated; the round €4.2M is a press simplification.

label: Declared liabilities (mortgage debt)
detail: Four BNP mortgage loans, with total monthly repayments of about €7,988, declared against the Paris real-estate holdings.

label: Life insurance (assurance-vie)
detail: Sole declared financial-investment holding; no securities portfolio, PEA or compte-titres was declared.

label: Bank account balances
detail: Cash balances declared in the 2022 HATVP déclaration de patrimoine.

label: Value of 90% stake in Rubempré (SARL)
detail: Declared value of his stake in his personal company Rubempré, at its 31 December 2020 balance-sheet value.

label: Le Figaro salary (déclaration d'intérêts)
detail: Declared remuneration as Le Figaro columnist for 2020.

label: Income via Rubempré (book royalties + media/conference fees, déclaration d'intérêts)
detail: Most of Zemmour's income was channelled through Rubempré rather than paid as salary; these are the year-by-year aggregate figures reported from his déclaration d'intérêts.

label: CNews 'Face à l'info' fees (press estimate)
detail: ESTIMATED, not from HATVP. CNews income was invoiced through Rubempré rather than appearing as a salary line. The frequently cited '€10,000+/month' CNews figure is not well substantiated.

label: Aggregate monthly income (press characterisation)
detail: ESTIMATED press aggregate of combined media and book income; not a single HATVP line. Treat as approximate.

label: Le Suicide français book sales (best-seller)
detail: ESTIMATED sales for his 2014 best-seller (Albin Michel). Royalty income is aggregated inside Rubempré; no isolated declared royalty figure for the title was located.
